scope_rules: Define O&D scope from ORD local routes and observed connecting paths, including endpoints other than ORD.
Retain all competing carrier offers/traffic in selected O&D markets when constructing shares/outside-airline controls.
Retain marketed UA/AA regional operations and linked resource/market closure before filtering.
Use AirportGroup and ordered TkCarrierGroup/OpCarrierGroup in DB1B Market to verify hub connections; fetch a scoped Coupon supplement only if those sequences prove insufficient.
Split empirical calibration/validation by departure cohort; a Q3 departure can have Q2 search dates.
Flag left-truncated booking windows near Apr16; do not treat earlier unobserved quotes as zero demand.
identification_limits: Passenger preference, price sensitivity and outside/nonpurchase conversion are not jointly identified by aggregate traffic and posted quotes alone.
Physical seats and capped seatsRemaining do not observe true rival residual inventory.
Current compile_scope does not itself fit weather transitions or load FlightPrices; those are separate calibration/observation tasks.
